relationships.subject: IDO1
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, IDO1 expression was increased in the ACC, and AAV-mediated IDO1 knockdown in the ACC rescued pain sensitivity, electrophysiological E/I balance changes, and anxiety-like behavior in chronic migraine model mice.

relationships.subject: IDO1
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blotting analysis revealed significantly elevated IFN-γ expression in the ACC of NTG-treated WT mice compared with both saline-treated WT mice and NTG-treated KO mice

relationships.subject: tilorone
relationships.evidence_quote: Tilorone dihydrochloride, an IFN agonist, attenuated mechanical pian thresholds in shRNA-treated mice following NTG injection, effectively reversing the rescue effect of IDO1 knockdown

key_findings: IDO1 is upregulated in the ACC in NTG chronic migraine; its knockdown or knockout rescues pain sensitivity, ACC E/I imbalance and anxiety-like behavior.
IDO1 drives microglial activation and Syn1 engulfment (synaptic pruning) in ACC via IFN signaling for pain, but not for anxiety.
